This Order shall take effect on July 10, 1950.
Done in the City of Manila, this 7th day of July, in the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and of the
Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
